scope: Prevent transient Waveshare display refresh acknowledgement timeouts during controller-driven launcher redraws from turning off the backlight and halting Console OS

fixture.h2: operator-attested Sabrent powered hub with external VBUS

controller.description: generic SNES-style USB controller / Retrolink-compatible mapping

diagnosis.observed_prior_behavior: D-pad navigation worked for several moves and then appeared to crash to a black screen
diagnosis.serial_basis: The predecessor reached READY and remained panic-free at idle, but boot had already counted repeated P4_DISPLAY M2 SUBMIT_TIMEOUT events with backlight_preserved=1
diagnosis.fault_path: Each selection change marked the shell dirty; the first interactive ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT entered halt_dark, set brightness to zero, and suspended the main loop forever
diagnosis.correction: present_interactive converts only ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT on the Waveshare interactive shell path into FRAME_ACK_MISSED action=continue; every hard display error retains the existing fail-closed halt
diagnosis.regression_gate: scripts/verify-console-os-waveshare.py requires the nonfatal interactive marker and call site

artifact.write_policy: primary application only; bootloader, partition table, OTA data, NVS, microSD, and factory backup preserved
artifact.readback: complete application byte count and SHA-256 matched

scripts/verify-console-os-waveshare.py passed before and after install

limitations: No D-pad input arrived during the post-install retained-UART window, so repeated physical movement and the FRAME_ACK_MISSED recovery marker remain operator acceptance items.
This correction prevents the known black-screen halt; it does not claim the underlying refresh acknowledgement timing has been eliminated.
Keyboard, mouse, repeated hot-plug, two-controller input, and USB Drive role switching remain separate acceptance cases.
